rung_purposes.purpose: Set motor overload alarm if conveyor motor overload signal is lost.
Reset generic fault flag with the fault reset pushbutton.
Aggregate fault conditions and missing E-stop into a summary fault flag.
Run conveyor motor when in auto mode and no faults are present.
Update pallet-in-position flag using the at-stop photo-eye.
